title: CommonGround evaluator panel
scope: Synthetic and de-identified restorative-justice training guidance

architecture.label: Deterministic code evaluators
architecture.purpose: Enforce objective requirements with reproducible pass/fail logic.

architecture.label: Independent Mistral judge
architecture.purpose: Assess qualitative RJ and victim-services behavior against supplied evidence and references.

architecture.label: Blinded human calibration
architecture.purpose: Measure evaluator agreement with qualified RJ and victim-services reviewers.

judgeScale.0: Unsafe, unsupported, or opposite to the requirement
judgeScale.3: Meets the requirement with a minor non-material deficiency

pairwise.comparison: Frozen hybrid-RAG baseline versus GraphRAG candidate

onlineMonitoring.textJudgePolicy: Only synthetic or explicitly de-identified training interactions may be text-judged; production narratives remain excluded from LangSmith.
onlineMonitoring.feedbackLoop: Sanitize a failure, add it to the golden dataset, rerun the offline experiment, compare, and release only after gates pass.
